name: ND Mini Browser
description: A keep-alive browser dashboard: open, switch, and close many real tabs of the ND built-in browser from a persistent chrome, with quick links and launcher quick-open. The session survives dialog closes, app navigation, and restarts — a sleeping tab resumes by URL.

commands.title: ND Mini Browser
commands.description: Open the mini browser chrome with your tab session and quick links.

commands.title: Open in browser tab
commands.description: Open the typed website as a new tab of the ND built-in browser — quick open, no chrome needed.

commands.title: Save quick link
commands.description: Save the typed website address as a quick link you can open any time.

views.title: Mini Browser
views.description: Your tab session and quick links. Type an address to open a real ND-browser tab; tabs keep running while you work.
